session.assistantText:
从 `state.mmd`（`[*] → Idle → Running → [*]`）导出为 SVG，源码在 [state.svg](state.svg)，渲染图直接贴在下面：

```dsh-ui
{"title": "状态机（state.svg）", "gap": 12, "items": [{"type": "svg", "title": "state.mmd 渲染出的状态机", "height": 240, "code": "<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 540 240" width="540" height="240" font-family="ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <marker id="dsh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#334155"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <rect x="14" y="60" width="512" height="120" rx="12" fill="none" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/>
  <text x="24" y="50" fill="#64748b" font-size="12">状态机</text>

  <circle cx="52" cy="120" r="20" fill="#334155"/>

  <g>
    <rect x="112" y="92" width="130" height="56" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="177" y="121" fill="#0f172a" font-size="15" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle">Idle</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="332" y="92" width="130" height="56" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="397" y="121" fill="#0f172a" font-size="15" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle">Running</text>
  </g>

  <circle cx="492" cy="120" r="20" fill="#334155"/>
  <circle cx="492" cy="120" r="13" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <path d="M 72 120 L 106 120" fill="none" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#dsh-arrow)"/>
  <path d="M 242 120 L 326 120" fill="none" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#dsh-arrow)"/>
  <path d="M 462 120 L 470 120" fill="none" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#dsh-arrow)"/>
</svg>
"}]}
```

说明：环境里没有 `mmdc`（Mermaid CLI），所以我按 Mermaid 的状态图约定手工画了等价的矢量图——初始/终止伪状态用实心圆加内白圆表示，状态为圆角矩形，迁移为带箭头直线。
